messages:
liz-peopleops: Hey team, quick run-down needed: I'm switching HSA providers next quarter. Does switching vendors affect 401(k) vesting or the employer match in any way?
sam-eng: HSA switch shouldn't touch 401k. different buckets. why the switch?
liz-peopleops: New vendor offers lower admin fees and better online access. Just want to confirm no hidden interactions.
drew-finance: Correct, HSA is separate from the 401k plan. Vendor migration for HSA only affects contributions/transfers for that HSA account. Employer 401k match and vesting rules remain as per our retirement plan doc.
benefits@redwood: Confirmed: HSA vendor change does not alter 401k match or vesting schedules. If you transfer HSA funds, thats between custodians only. We recommend notifying payroll to update contribution destination and double-check automatic deductions.
liz-peopleops: Thanks — should we pause deductions during the cutover week to avoid double withholding?
drew-finance: Good idea to pause for one pay period. Submit a payroll change for that paycheck. Also file the HSA transfer form with the new custodian to avoid long processing gaps.
hr-bot: Action items: liz-peopleops to submit payroll pause request; benefits@redwood to provide HSA transfer checklist.
benefits@redwood: Checklist posted to benefits portal under "HSA migrations".
